purpose: DTJ Standard Product Page v1 (Harsh, 10 Oct 2026): the SAME sections in the SAME order with the SAME blocks for every product, from the ThrillX 'Ecom Product Based Landing Page' wireframe (Figma 2460-4368 / 2460-5367). Only content and colours change per brand. Spec: .claude/skills/dtj-pdp-factory/references/wireframe-ecom-product.md. A section without content is left out of the page until its content (real or SAMPLE) exists; it is never reordered or replaced.

roles._comment: Background role per section. bold = electric / playful vibes (the brand colour, the ink and the accent as full bands); calm = every other vibe (white and a soft tint). A role equal to the one above becomes plain (lint L04).
roles._bold_why: Harsh, 10 Oct 2026 (Go Mints v2 review): the customer photos and the numbers sit on white (the numbers keep ink cards), the reviews band stays dark with white cards; FAQ moves to the brand band and the stories to white so no two neighbours match.

order: price with the real compare-at and the saving
buybox.why: The wireframe's buy box (W02): everything that answers 'what is it, what does it cost, why believe it' within one thumb of Add to cart.
